ModMetaData.name: Ponies of the Rim — Flight Traits
ModMetaData.author: Dreamer
ModMetaData.description:
Flight Traits adds a collection of flight-focused personality traits and life stories for flying ponies in RimWorld.
Traits shape each pony’s aerial style: some are faster or can stay airborne longer, while others recover stamina more quickly or trade one advantage for a drawback. Powerful all-around flight traits are intentionally uncommon, so exceptional flyers stand out.
This add-on also gives selected Pegasus backstories flight-related modifiers. Rainbow Dash’s unique childhood and Wonderbolt career together provide approximately +30% flight speed, +40% maximum flight stamina, and +20% stamina recovery.
Flight modifiers apply through Ponies of the Rim’s flight system. Generation filtering is intended to keep flight-specific traits and stories exclusive to eligible flying pawns.
Requires RimWorld 1.6, Harmony, and Ponies of the Rim - Core.
